steps.label: Zero out rigid-body gravity (previously unexercised by any scenario -- rigid SetGravity is distinct from fluid's SetFluidGravity)
Precondition: sphere starts at drop height y=3
Invariant (negative control): with zero gravity, the sphere does not fall
Widen the time step (previously unexercised as a live rigid-body knob)
Run under gravity, fewer iterations, larger step (~2s at the new step size)
Change: with gravity restored, the sphere actually falls
Invariant: still bounded (not exploding despite the coarser solver settings)
